headline: Argentina Country Risk Surges Past 930 Points as Peso Weakens to $1,585
summary: Argentina's country risk index climbed over 80 points to 930, while the retail exchange rate touched a new annual high of $1,585 per dollar and Argentine ADRs dropped up to 9% in New York.
why: Argentina's sovereign risk spread reflects sovereign default risk and borrowing costs, impacting debt restructuring and corporate financing.

impacts.name: Argentine Peso
impacts.why: The peso slid to $1,585 per dollar amid broader capital flight and mounting macroeconomic uncertainty.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Surging sovereign risk spreads and a weakening currency triggered sharp declines in Argentine sovereign bonds and equities listed in New York.
